description: This file contains a unit test that verifies the behavior of setting maximum event listeners on an EventEmitter object. It imports utilities and testing functions, creates an EventEmitter instance, performs assertions on its internal state before and after calling setMaxListeners.

classes.name: EventEmitter
classes.description: An event-driven class supporting event listener registration and configuration, imported from './utils'.

methods.name: setMaxListeners
methods.description: Method of EventEmitter that sets the maximum number of listeners for an event.
